title: Replace [u8; 16] with Ipv6Addr in lichen-rpl/src/table.rs RouteTarget, RouteEntry, RoutingTable (19 occurrences)
close_reason: Replaced [u8; 16] with core::net::Ipv6Addr across lichen-rpl table.rs address-shaped API (RouteEntry.path, RoutingTable rpl_managed_hosts/rpl_managed_prefixes, add_route/remove_route/mark_stale/mark_expired/entry_state/lookup/add_prefix_route; RouteTarget::host+contains take Ipv6Addr, RouteTarget::new/prefix intentionally keep raw bit-masked prefix bytes). Bridged routing.rs, node Router::lookup_route(_at)/inject_route, rpl_stack plan_route (RoutePlan stays raw), gateway mesh_to_mesh/is_local_mesh paths, and ~70 test call sites. 3 reviewer passes (kimi-k3: correctness/security/edge-cases) all PASS; reviewer-pass findings filed: worker6-767l (pre-existing failing test three_rpl_stacks_send_leaf_dao_via_preferred_parent, verified failing at 1cd8b86784 pre-change) and worker6-4iax (pre-existing routing.rs:949 empty-path index underflow). Clippy warnings introduced by the change fixed (15 useless conversions + 1 identity map); remaining warnings verified pre-existing at 1cd8b86784. cargo test: lichen-rpl 15/15 suites green (316 tests); lichen-node 345/346 (1 pre-existing RED, filed); lichen-gateway 252/253 (1 deliberately-RED per bead ljgs). Code landed via auto-sync commits 6af03283c2+7993672ba2 (external worker7 sync); nothing left to commit except .beads store writes.
